gloss: to spare time; to find time for

definitions.gloss: to spare time; to make time for; to find time
definitions.explanation: To allocate or set aside time from a busy schedule for something. Implies that one is busy and making an effort to find time.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}を{割|さ}いてくれた。
examples.english: They spared their time for me.

examples.japanese: お{忙|いそが}しいところ{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}いていただきありがとうございます。
examples.english: Thank you for taking the time out of your busy schedule.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{少|すこ}しでも{読書|どくしょ}に{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}くようにしている。
examples.english: I try to set aside at least a little time every day for reading.

notes:
The verb {割|さ}く means to split or divide, giving the image of carving out a portion from a busy schedule.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {時間|じかん}を{割|さ}く: to spare/make time
- ～に{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}く: to devote time to ~
- {時間|じかん}を{割|さ}いていただく: to have someone spare their time (humble/polite)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勉強|べんきょう}に{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}く: to spare time for study
- {趣味|しゅみ}に{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}く: to make time for hobbies

REGISTER:
Very common in polite business contexts, especially when thanking someone: お{忙|いそが}しいところ{時間|じかん}を{割|さ}いていただきありがとうございます。

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時間|じかん}を{作|つく}る: to make time (more casual)
- {時間|じかん}を{取|と}る: to take time (neutral)
